## Deputies Elections

There have been 7 elections (7 contested) for Deputy held in St Brelade No 2 since 2002.

* * *

### 2002 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (2 seats), 27th November 2002.

**[Peter Troy](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/peter-troy) and [Julian Bernstein](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/julian-bernstein) were elected as Deputies of St Brelade No 2 in 2002.**

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Peter Troy](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/peter-troy)** |  | 961 | 61.2% |
| 2 | **[Julian Bernstein](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/julian-bernstein)** |  | 640 | 40.8% |
| 3 | [Jane Wakeham](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/jane-wakeham) |  | 599 | 38.2% |
| 4 | [Terry Coutanche](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/terry-coutanche) |  | 397 | 25.3% |
| 5 | [Stefan Gough](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/stefan-gough) |  | 193 | 12.3% |
| 6 | [Robert Partridge](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/robert-partridge) |  | 92 | 5.9% |

1,570 ballots (inc. 16 spoilt papers)

4,238 registered voters

37% turnout
